主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (BLONDER) sold its Old Bridge, New Jersey facility to Jake Brown Rd LLC on February 1, 2019, for $10.5 million, with $130,000 advanced for property repairs. The lease includes a five-year term, with an option for an additional five years. Base rent for the first year is $836,855.50, with subsequent years’ rent at 102.5% of the prior year. A security deposit of eight months’ base rent may be reduced to three months upon meeting benchmarks. The sale triggered executive compensation adjustments, including a $165,000 bonus for the CEO, and $225,000 and $152,000 salary increases for the CFO and Vice President – Sales, respectively. These changes were delayed until the sale completion to manage cash resources. The lease details are referenced to the attached form of lease. The company filed a Form 8-K on February 6, 2019, incorporating the 2017 10-K and other filings. The filing includes Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2, which are the Consent Under Loan and Security Agreement and the Debt Conversion and Lien Termination Agreement, respectively. The report was signed by Eric Skolnik, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on February 6, 2019.
